lone_wolf.name: Lone Wolf
lone_wolf.description: Just trying to survive. No agenda.
intro_lines: Hey... you got food? I haven't eaten in days.
Don't shoot. I'm clean. No bites.
I lost my group last week. Mind if I tag along?
I can pull my weight. I swear.

militia.name: Free Militia
intro_lines: Identify yourself. Slowly.
We're rebuilding. Order matters now more than ever.
You armed? Show me.

raiders.name: Raiders
raiders.description: Take what they want. Smile while doing it.
intro_lines: Friendly! Just friendly. Got anything to spare?
Nice setup you got. Real nice.
Look, I know we got off on the wrong foot...

cannibals.name: The Long Pig Society
intro_lines: Oh thank god, another person! It's been so long.
I have a camp nearby. Plenty of food. You should come.
We're not animals. We have rules. We have... recipes.
You look thin. Let us feed you.

cultists.name: Children of the Risen
cultists.description: Worship the dead. Believe the bite is a sacrament.
intro_lines: The Risen will inherit. Will you?
Have you been Chosen yet, friend?
I've seen the truth. The dead are awake; the living merely sleep.

doctors.name: Mercy Corps Remnants
doctors.description: Medical staff still trying. Saints, mostly.
intro_lines: Are you injured? I have supplies.
I was a nurse. Before. I still am, I think.
Please — I just want to help people.

scavengers.name: Scavenger Crew
intro_lines: What you got? I'll trade.
Heard there's a Costco two days east. Untouched. Maybe.
Numbers help. Want to split a haul?
